Potoverで取り扱う情報、その利用目的、保存期間について説明します。: This policy explains the information Potover handles, how it is used, and how long it is retained.

アカウントを作成する場合、メールアドレスとパスワードを取得します。パスワードはハ: When you create an account, we collect your email address and password. Passwords are stored as hashes, not in plain text.
ログイン後は、ブックマーク、閲覧した記事の学習履歴、フォローした情報源、コンテン: After you sign in, we store your bookmarks, learning history of articles you have viewed, followed sources, and settings such as preferred content language, theme, and search criteria. To manage retention periods, we also record when you last used a feature requiring authentication. For authentication sessions, a token is stored in your browser’s local storage, and a hash of that token is stored on the server.
不正利用防止のため、認証操作の回数制限に利用するIPアドレス由来のハッシュ値を一: To prevent misuse, we temporarily store hashes derived from IP addresses to rate-limit authentication operations. The original IP addresses are not stored in these rate-limit records, and the records are deleted regularly.
利用目的と保存期間: Purposes of Use and Retention Periods
取得した情報は、アカウント認証、ブックマーク・学習履歴・設定の同期、不正利用の防: We use the information we collect to authenticate accounts, synchronize bookmarks, learning history, and settings, prevent misuse, respond to inquiries, and provide and improve the service.
アカウント、メールアドレス、ブックマーク、学習履歴、フォロー情報、設定の保存期間: Our general retention policy for accounts, email addresses, bookmarks, learning history, followed sources, and settings is two years from the last authenticated use. To prevent accidental deletion during migration, automatic account deletion remains disabled until the operator reviews the affected accounts and migration measures and explicitly enables it. Accounts whose past usage dates have not been verified will not be automatically deleted based solely on their registration dates. When an account is deleted, this data is removed from the active database.
認証セッションは発行から30日で無効となり、期限切れの記録は日次の自動処理で削除: Authentication sessions expire 30 days after issuance, and expired records are deleted by a daily automated process. IP-derived hashes used for authentication rate limits are deleted approximately 24–48 hours after they are recorded.
Cloudflare D1の復旧用履歴には、データベース削除後も削除前の状態がプ: Even after deletion from the database, the state before deletion may remain in Cloudflare D1’s recovery history, depending on the plan. According to Cloudflare’s guidance, this is up to 7 days on the Workers Free plan and up to 30 days on the Paid plan.
アプリケーションとアカウントデータの保存にはCloudflare Pages、W: We use Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and D1 to host the application and store account data. Google AdSense is used from the initial launch, and cookies and similar technologies may be used to serve ads. Please refer to each service’s privacy information for details on how it handles information.
記事・動画のリンク先は外部サイトです。リンク先での情報の取扱いは、それぞれの運営: Article and video links lead to external websites. Information on those sites is handled according to their respective operators’ policies. Potover has not configured an analytics service.

サービス内容や情報の取扱いに変更がある場合、このページを更新します。重要な変更は: We will update this page if the service or our handling of information changes. Significant changes will also be announced within the service.

Potoverは、ポーカー学習に役立つ記事・動画等を探すための情報整理サービスで: Potover is an information organization service for finding articles, videos, and other resources to help you learn poker.
